title: SKY UX Dev Infra configuration
description: Configuration for the SKY UX development infrastructure CLI (`skyux-dev`), read from the `.skyuxdev.json` file at the workspace root.

$schema.description: The URL or path to the JSON schema for this file.

baseBranch.description: The name of the branch that releases are based on (e.g., `main` or `14.x.x`).

expectedRegistryUrl.description: The NPM registry URL that packages are expected to be published to. Publishing aborts if the configured registry does not match this value.

implicitPeerDependencies.description: A collection of implicit peer dependencies, keyed by the Nx project name. Used when static analysis cannot detect a dependency through an import or export. For example, the library may create an artifact or configuration that expects another package to be installed by the consumer.

offsetPackageVersions.description: A map of placeholder versions to version offsets, used to derive package versions during a packages distribution build. Each key is a placeholder version (e.g., `0.0.0-PLACEHOLDER`) and each value is a `major[.minor]` offset applied to the base SKY UX version.

packageNameUsedToDetermineDistTags.description: The name of the published NPM package whose dist-tags are used to determine the dist-tags for the workspace's packages.

releaseBranch.description: A pattern for the name of release branches. The string `{baseBranch}` is replaced with the value of `baseBranch`. For example, if `baseBranch` is `main` and `releaseBranch` is `release/{baseBranch}`, the resulting release branch name is `release/main`.

resourcesModulePaths.description: Overrides the location and name of the generated library resources module, keyed by the Nx project name. The value is the path passed to the `@skyux/i18n:lib-resources-module` generator, relative to the library's source root. Defaults to `lib/modules/shared/sky-<projectName>`.
